service1.title: Furniture assembly and disassembly
service1.desc: Professional assembly and disassembly of all types of furniture - wardrobes, bedrooms and sectionals. Fast, precise and with attention to detail, we guarantee complete strength and perfect leveling of your new or old furniture.

service2.title: Electrical Services
service2.desc: Professional installation and replacement of lighting fixtures, switches and outlets for your home or office. I ensure safe connections, precise work and reliability of the electrical installation to guarantee your comfort and peace of mind.

service3.title: Plumbing Services
service3.desc: Professional and clean installation of faucets (cartridges) for sinks, shut-off valves and bathroom furniture. I guarantee leak prevention, correctness and quality installation of each assembly, so you can save time and future repairs.
